info.desc: Nimrod is the fifth studio album by American rock band Green Day, released on October 14, 1997, by Reprise Records. .

podcast.body: Released in 1997, this album, along with Insomniac and Warning, achieved "okay" sales, but these figures were notably overshadowed by the massive commercial success of Dookie. "After that record came Nimrod and warning. All three records sold okay, but in the shadow of Ducy, the numbers were just that. Okay."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Green Day: From their Beginning to 2005

podcast.body: The song that originated as the B-side to "Brain Stew" was later re-recorded and included on the "Nimrod" album. This re-recording and album inclusion helped the song become one of Green Day's biggest hits after its initial B-side status. "Got re-recorded for the Nimrod album and then became one of Green Day's biggest hits."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Digital Debris Part 1: B-Sides and Bonus Tracks
